raw.query: SELECT d.run_id, d.experiment, d.pool, d.window_name, d.n_replicas, d.encoder_workers, p.sla_metric, p.p50_ms, p.p90_ms, p.p99_ms, p.max_ms, p.n_requests, p.source_relation FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS p ON p.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current = TRUE AND (ROUND(p.p50_ms::numeric, 2) IN (11.30, 8.16) OR ROUND(p.p90_ms::numeric, 2) IN (11.30, 8.16) OR ROUND(p.p99_ms::numeric, 2) IN (11.30, 8.16) OR ROUND(p.max_ms::numeric, 2) IN (11.30, 8.16)) ORDER BY d.run_id, p.sla_metric
raw.claimed: N=1: measured 11.30 ms, composed 8.16 ms, ratio 1.38
raw.evidence: No current v_pool_latency metric rounds to either claimed latency, so the expected owning view cannot substantiate the row or its ratio.
raw.fix: Add or identify the current v_pool_latency rows backing measured and composed latency at N=1, with a shared comparable population and denominator.
